Qualification qual-20260913 therefore failed TC_QUALIFIED_PATH_INVARIANT with pinned_mismatch ['run_mass_roc_session'] although ast.dump matched exactly and the function was never edited (the file is byte-identical across 90d9fe8, ee2c167 and f3d246e; its last change was 2026-09-12). Literal source text is interpreter-independent and strictly stricter than unparse.
